sentences.text: Wellbore 15/9-F-9 A has 28 daily reports, from 2009-07-03 to 2016-10-23.
The report span is 2670.0 days and the wellbore has 28 active days.
Three campaigns are recorded, each separated by a gap of more than 30 days.
Total depth is 1206.0 m measured depth and 1013.0 m true vertical depth, both from the deepest reported report.
Total activity time is 555.75 h, of which primary lost time is 60.25 h, or 10.84% of activity time.
Sodir records entry on 2009-07-01 and completion (end of drilling) on 2009-07-09, with status P&A.

Main outcome: the well was drilled to 1206.0 m measured depth in the first campaign, completed with a sand screen and an electrical submersible pump (ESP), reworked in the second campaign with repeated failed plug and tubing-handling operations, and plugged and abandoned in the third.
Campaign 1 runs from 2009-07-03 to 2009-07-14, spans 12.0 d, has 12 active days and is dominated by drilling.
Campaign 2 runs from 2015-01-26 to 2015-02-04, spans 10.0 d, has 10 active days and is dominated by workover.
Campaign 3 runs from 2016-09-28 to 2016-10-23, spans 26.0 d, has 6 active days and is dominated by plug and abandonment.

Campaigns 2 and 3 both come after the 2009 completion: campaign 2 pulled the completion string and re-ran ESP equipment, and campaign 3 plugged and abandoned the well, which explains why the last report is later than the Sodir completion date.
Section 1 is 12.25 in hole, drilled from 2009-07-03 to 2009-07-06 from 436.0 m to 997.0 m measured depth, with 561.0 m of new hole.
Section 1 ends at 903.3 m true vertical depth, and its average rate while coded drilling was 17.26 m/h; this averages all time coded drilling, not on-bottom rate of penetration.
Section 2 is 8.5 in, drilled on 2009-07-07 from 997.0 m to 1051.0 m (930.0 m true vertical), with 54.0 m of new hole at an average of 13.5 m/h while coded drilling.

Section 3 has no reported hole size (hole size unknown); it was drilled on 2009-07-08 to 1206.0 m measured depth (1013.0 m true vertical), with 155.0 m of new hole at an average of 12.92 m/h while coded drilling. Its recorded start depth equals its end depth and does not match the end of section 2, so only its end depth and new hole are used.
Section 4 is a completion section with hole size unknown, running from 2009-07-09 to 2009-07-10 with 48.0 h of activity and no new hole; no time was coded drilling, so no drilling rate is reported.
Section 5 is a completion section with hole size unknown, running from 2009-07-11 to 2009-07-14 with 93.75 h of activity, of which 19.0 h was interruption; it drilled no new hole.
Section 6 is a workover section with hole size unknown, running from 2015-01-26 to 2015-01-28 with 56.5 h of activity; it drilled no new hole, and its end depth true vertical is not reported.
Section 7 is a workover section with hole size unknown, running from 2015-01-29 to 2015-01-31 with 72.0 h of activity, of which 49.5 h was interruption; it drilled no new hole.
Section 8 is a completion section with hole size unknown on 2015-02-01, with 24.0 h of activity and 10.25 h of interruption; it drilled no new hole.
Section 9 is a completion section with hole size unknown on 2015-02-02, with 24.0 h of activity and 1.25 h of interruption; it drilled no new hole.
Section 10 is a completion section with hole size unknown, running from 2015-02-03 to 2015-02-04 with 27.5 h of activity and 1.75 h of interruption; it drilled no new hole.
Section 11 is a moving section with hole size unknown on 2016-09-28, with 7.75 h of activity and 4.5 h of interruption; no end depth is reported.
Section 12 is a plug and abandonment section with hole size unknown, running from 2016-09-29 to 2016-10-23 with 63.0 h of activity, of which 21.25 h was interruption; no end depth is reported.
Section 1 starts below a casing shoe at 436.5 m and sets a liner whose shoe is at 996.0 m; the activity text reads "Picked up 9 5/8" liner shoe".
Section 2 starts below the 996.0 m casing shoe and sets no casing; the tool records no casing shoe for it.
Section 3 starts below the 996.0 m casing shoe and sets no casing.

sentences.text: On 2016-09-29 spear and junk-mill runs fished for the dropped string; the fishing activities took 3.0 h of primary lost time, and the report notes that a bull nose was missing in the well.
On 2016-09-30 an EZSV bridge plug and a balanced cement plug were placed as part of the abandonment.
On 2016-10-16 the riser pull for abandonment waited on weather, a primary lost time of 9.75 h across the 2016-10-16 to 2016-10-17 operations.
Before lifting a stuck wellhead component, confirm the release bolts and rigging, because the 2015 tubing bonnet lift needed 2.75 h of attempts.
Verify plug setting depth and tool function before running, because section 7 lost 21.75 h of primary time, 30.21% of its activity time, mostly to plug setting and pressure-test repairs.
Inspect tubing threads and check make-up before running, since the 2015 damaged threads cost 0.75 h of primary time and the 2016 tubing drop cost a further 0.75 h.
Plan the abandonment riser pull with a weather margin, because 9.75 h of primary time was waiting on weather in section 12.
Carry a backup survey method for the directional runs, since the 2009 GMWD survey failed and cost 1.0 h of possible time.
Record hole size for every section, because sections 4 to 12 have hole size unknown, so their drilling and lost-time rates cannot be compared with the 12.25 in and 8.5 in sections.

row.comments: Made several attempts to take GMWD survey without success.

Ran in hole with 9 5/8" liner from 423 m to 424, 4 m. Took weight at 424, 4 m (Casing window). Maximum set down weight 17 tons. Made several attempts to pass through window with various orientations. BO last liner joint and installed same in hydraulic mouse hole. Installed circulation swage and DP safety valve. Stabbed liner joint and circulation assembly with PRS. Made up liner joint with casing tong. Connected TDS.
Picked up 9 5/8" liner shoe and filled same with 1.40 sg mud and verified integrity of float - OK. Made up and ran in hole with 9 5/8" liner intermediate joint; tube-locked connection.
Picked up, made up and ran in hole with 6 5/8" screens to 199 m.
Continued attempts to pull riser. Moved riser, adjusted bolts, tried to re-position lock ring.
Could not disconnect riser from well head. Contacted town, trouble shot.
Troubleshot problems with lock ring between riser and wellhead. TBT with on comming crew.
Adjusted release bolts to press lock ring in centre. Took 3 ton over pull, slacked off to neutral. Continued to adjust stroke of bolts. Riser free.
Attempted to lift spacer spool and tubing bonnet without success, +/- 3 ton overpull. Slacked off weight and retried several times. No movement.

Reconfigured rig up and installed a 5 ton chain hoist for better control over weight taken. Simultaneously loosened ALT-2 release bolts. Attempted to lift tubing bonnet and spacer spool, 4 ton overpull, little movement observed, but still not free.
Removed chain hoist and re-attached double slings to ensure straight-up lift. Pulled up, backed out release bolts and pulled tubing bonnet free. Covered tubing hanger with bucket.
Problems with smart zone on drillfloor equipment. Stop in operation. Electrical technician investigated problems. Meanwhile performed TBT for running TH RT with new crew.

Attempted to set Timelock plug according to Archer procedures. Made 3 attempts without sucess. Archer rep contacted onshore support for advice. Performed TBT with new crew. Observed that the plug was not at the required setting depth - attempted set in 13 3/8" casing. RIH with Timelock plug from 395 m to 424 m.
Installed lifting eyes and bridle. Pulled diverter inserts. 10" diverter inserts released from interlock, fell out and landed off on top of the riser.

Attempted to pressure tested well to 34 bar against Timelock plug and diverter packer. Pressured up well in steps and monitored:
11 bar / 165 ltr
24 bar / 56 ltr
26 bar / 8 ltr
28 bar / 7 ltr
29 bar / 3 ltr
30 bar / 5 ltr (pressure drop observed)
31 bar / 9 ltr 
32 bar / 8 ltr 
Aborted at 32 bar. Pressure dropped and stabilized at 23,5 bar. No good test. Bled off pressure to cement unit.
P/U first 7 5/8" tubing joint from HTS. Attempted to M/U same to ESP assy. Not able to get good connection. Trouble to B/O connection. B/O and observed damaged threads. L/O tubing joint.
Evaluated situation.
Accidently dropped 212m of tubing string by operator error. Performed time out for safety conversation with all involved. Took pictures
P/U and M/U spear BHA to fish 7 5/8in tubing string. RIF and tagged top of the fish at 200m
Worked string f/ 200.1m to 200.7m with up to 6t WOB while rotating at 5rpm CCW 5kNM. Not able to engage the fish
POOH w/ spear BHA from 200m to surface. Inspected spear. Observed bull nose missing in the well
Established circulation and washed the setting area, 550 l/min/ 4 bar. Installed the 13 3/8  EZSV plug at 199,2 m top of plug (35 right hand turns). Load tested the plug with 10t down weight

Balanced cement plug (148 m - 199 m ): Mixed and pumped 5,0 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with 1800 l of drill water 1000 l/min/ 14 bar. Pulled out of cement to 148m at 2 min/stand. Theoretical TOC 148 m

Waited on weather to pull production riser on F-15 D

Meanwhile:
Performed TBT for skidding to F-9 A and tag TOC
